visual.general_description: Five-panel composite of paired coronal and axial chest CT images in lung window, labelled A to E.
visual.detailed_description: Ten grayscale CT images arranged as five lettered panels, A to C stacked on the left and D and E on the right. Each panel has a narrow coronal image beside a wider axial image, with a cyan R orientation marker beside each image and a black bold panel letter at the upper left. Panel A shows a right hilar mass-like opacity; panels B and C show widespread bilateral patchy hazy opacities with reticular and polygonal crazy-paving patterns; panel D shows right-predominant patchy consolidation; panel E shows a round dense nodular opacity at the right hilum with distorted surrounding lung. No names, dates or numeric overlays are printed on the images.

panels.general_description: Baseline coronal and axial chest CT in lung window.
panels.detailed_description: Panel A shows a coronal image on the left and an axial image on the right. The axial image shows a large irregular soft-tissue opacity in the right lung near the hilum with spiculated margins and fine linear septal lines in the surrounding right lung; the left lung looks comparatively clear with visible vessels. The coronal image shows increased opacity in the right mid to upper lung. Printed on the image are the panel letter and a small cyan R orientation marker beside each image; no patient name, date or numeric overlay is visible.

visual.general_description: Annotated chart of serial ALC and WBC with numbered clinical-event callouts and a three-phase timeline.
visual.detailed_description: Two stacked plots share a white background above a three-colour timeline band. The upper plot has a y-axis labelled ALC (×10^9/L) with ticks 0.5, 1.0, 1.5 and 2.0 and a dashed dark-green curve through seven red round markers, each with a printed value (1.87, 0.48, 2.13, 1.28, 0.60, 0.49, 1.65). The lower plot has a y-axis labelled WBC (×10^9/L) with ticks 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 and a dashed dark-green curve through seven green round markers with printed values (5.82, 3.22, 7.17, 8.56, 8.89, 6.18, 9.05); a black asterisk is printed on the lower curve. Dashed blue arrows link some callouts to the curves, and two red spiky burst symbols mark callouts 7 and 8. Twelve numbered callouts with bullet or symbol markers describe events: 1 NSCLC Dx (EGFR ex19del); 2 Erlotinib initiated with FVC68% DLCO52%; 3 Erlotinib D/C with CTCAE G3 dermatitis; 4 Osimertinib initiated; 5 Osimertinib D/C with SpO2 90%; 6 lymphocytopenia crisis with ALC=0.48×10^9/L; 7 Anti-MAC + MP pulse; 8 Erlotinib reintroduced, undiagnosed infection; 9 CMV pneumonitis Dx, CD4+ lymphocytopenia 0.16×10^9/L, Ganciclovir IV; 10 CD4+ lymphocytopenia 0.15×10^9/L; 11 CMV clearance/Discharge; 12 Terminal outcome, Fibrosis (irreversible), FVC48% DLCO42%. Each callout also prints a calendar date. A horizontal TIMELINE arrow beneath carries seven printed calendar date labels and three boxed phases on coloured backgrounds: Phase I: Targeted Therapy (teal), Phase II: Diagnostic Challenge (yellow) and Phase III: Clinical Outcomes (pink).
